trust.paymentOther: Careful: only money paid through Isoko is held safely until the job is done. If you pay outside, a dispute cannot get it back.

trust.contactNote: Sharing a number is fine for arranging the visit. Keep payment on Isoko so the job stays protected.
trust.adminSub: What users have reported about each other. Close each as handled or dismissed; the reporter is told which.

trust.dismissBody: Use this when nothing needs doing. The reporter is told it was reviewed.
trust.suspendBody: They are signed out at once and cannot log in until an admin reactivates them. The report is closed as handled.

credentials.title: Proof of skill

tierHelp.self_declared: The worker told us they do this. Nobody has checked it yet.
tierHelp.document_sighted: A reviewer looked at a certificate the worker provided. That confirms the document was seen. It is not a check of whether the award itself is genuine.
tierHelp.peer_reviewed: Independent reviewers examined evidence of the work and approved it. The reviewers are assigned automatically and cannot be chosen by the worker.
tierHelp.work_earned: Built from jobs completed and reviewed on Isoko.
tierHelp.supervised: A verified worker endorsed them after a paid job together. It is real experience, but the endorser is not independent, so it counts for less than a review.

credentials.addHint: Photograph a paper certificate or upload a PDF. A reviewer will confirm they have seen it. We cannot verify the award itself.
credentials.certTitlePlaceholder: For example: TVET Level 3 in Electronics
credentials.declareHint: Tell clients what you do. You can add proof later. A skill with no proof still shows, marked as self-declared.
credentials.honestNotice: Isoko confirms a reviewer saw your certificate. It does not confirm the certificate is genuine, and it never claims to.

adminNav.gigApprovalsSub: New gigs wait here until an admin checks them. Approve to put them live; the ranked shortlist is invited at once.
adminNav.skillReviewsSub: Skill submissions waiting on a decision, laid open with their evidence.
adminNav.jobsSub: Work under way and work finished, with where the money stands.
adminNav.paymentsSub: Money on the platform: waiting to be collected, held in escrow, paid out and refunded.
adminNav.usersSub: Suspend an account to block sign-in immediately, or delete it permanently.
adminNav.reviewersSub: Who reviews skill evidence. Peers are well-rated workers; the rotation rules decide who sees what.
adminNav.auditSub: Signs of reviewers and workers favouring each other. A flag is a prompt to look, not a finding.
adminNav.metricsSub: The measurements behind the research questions: does ranking get work accepted, and do newcomers get a fair start?

actions.approveApplicantBody: They are asked to confirm they are still available; the other applicants stay pending until they do.
actions.suspendBody: They are signed out and cannot sign in until reactivated.

protection.title: Protected by Isoko
protection.escrowDetail: The client pays in when the job is accepted; the worker is paid when it is done.
protection.codeDetail: The client hands over a 4-digit code on site. No code, no release.
protection.disputeDetail: Three independent members decide, never anyone tied to either side.
protection.receiptDetail: Checkable by anyone, and listed on the worker’s income statement.

fairwork.title: Fairwork scorecard
fairwork.subtitle: Isoko scored against the five Fairwork principles for platform work, from its own records, recomputed every time this page loads.
fairwork.about: Fairwork, at the Oxford Internet Institute, rates gig platforms in 38 countries on fair pay, conditions, contracts, management and representation, two points each. We apply the same principles to ourselves, live, and show the number behind every point.
fairwork.c_payAtFloor: Jobs pay at least the usual low end for the trade
fairwork.c_payAtFloor_d: Share of payouts at or above the 25th percentile of what that trade pays on Isoko.
fairwork.c_noCommission: Workers keep the full agreed price
fairwork.c_noCommission_d: Share of payouts with no platform commission taken from the worker.
fairwork.c_escrowProtected: Pay is protected before work starts
fairwork.c_escrowProtected_d: Share of completed jobs whose payment was held in escrow and released.
fairwork.c_disputesOnTime_d: Share of disputes decided, or still within, the 5 days promised.
fairwork.c_receipts: Every payout has a checkable receipt
fairwork.c_receipts_d: Share of released payments that produced receipted payouts.
fairwork.c_explained_d: Share of applications and invitations that carry the reasons behind their ranking.
fairwork.c_appealsHandled_d: Share of appeals against reviewers decided, or still within 14 days.
fairwork.c_reasonsGiven_d: Share of rejected applications that carry a reason.
fairwork.c_peerReviewers_d: Workers enrolled as peer reviewers of skill evidence.
fairwork.c_workerVoice_d: Polls on platform rules in the last year that workers paid through Isoko voted on and the platform answered publicly.

safetyNet.title: Safety net
safetyNet.subtitle: Money your clients have added for sick days and emergencies. It is yours to draw on.
safetyNet.ejoHezaHelp: Set aside this share of every payout toward Ejo Heza, Rwanda’s long-term savings scheme.
safetyNet.whyPlaceholder: For example: clinic visit, rent while sick
safetyNet.empty: Nothing yet. When a client adds to your safety net, it shows here.
safetyNet.addHelp: {{amount}} RWF goes to the worker’s safety net when the job is paid out.
safetyNet.noneHelp: You can add a small amount for the worker’s sick days and emergencies.
safetyNet.simulated: Ejo Heza transfers are simulated in this demo.

safety.title: Safety
safety.contactHelp: Your trusted contact gets a text when you arrive at a job, when you leave it, and at once if you press SOS.

safety.checkedIn: Checked in. Your contact was texted.
safety.checkedOut: Checked out. Your contact was told you left safely.

voice.denied: Allow microphone access to record a voice note.
voice.gigHint: Describe the job aloud, in any language, up to 2 minutes. Workers hear it beside your written description.

authPanel.title: Turn your skills into income.
authPanel.body: Isoko Talents connects skilled workers in Kigali with people who need their work. Post a job, get matched, get paid safely.
authPanel.escrowLabel: Paid when the job is done

workerVoice.title: Worker Voice
workerVoice.subtitle: Workers decide the rules that affect their pay. Vote on open questions and see what the platform did with every result.
workerVoice.notYet: You can vote once you have been paid for a job through Isoko. Until then, you can follow every result here.
workerVoice.voteFailed: Could not count your vote. Try again.
workerVoice.adminSub: Put a platform rule to the workers. Only workers paid through Isoko vote, once each. Close a poll by saying what you will do; every voter is told.
workerVoice.question: Question
workerVoice.questionHint: For example: should cancellations after 24 hours pay the worker 20%?
workerVoice.openHint: Every worker who can vote is notified.
workerVoice.opened: Poll opened. Workers have been told.
workerVoice.openFailed: That did not work. Check the poll and try again.
workerVoice.closeBody: Write what the platform will do about the result. It is published beside the counts and sent to every voter.
workerVoice.outcomeHint: For example: workers chose 5%, so the suggestion on the pay-in screen is now 5%.
workerVoice.closedMsg: Poll closed and the answer published.
workerVoice.publicSub: Questions put to workers who have been paid through Isoko, the counts, and what the platform did.

cover.policyLine: Policy {{policy}} · medical costs up to {{limit}} RWF from an accident on this job
cover.claimIntro: Tell us what happened and what the treatment costs. Cover pays medical costs up to {{limit}} RWF, for claims made during the job or up to {{days}} days after it is paid.
cover.whatHappenedHint: For example: I cut my hand on the cutting table and needed three stitches at the health centre.
cover.claimSent: Claim sent. An admin will review it and you will be told the decision.
cover.claimFailed: Could not send the claim. Try again.
cover.addHelp: Covers {{name}}'s medical costs, up to {{limit}} RWF, if they are hurt doing this job.
cover.adminSub: Accident claims from workers on covered jobs. Approve to have the insurer pay, or decline with the reason; the worker is told either way. The insurer is simulated in this pilot.
cover.approveBody: The insurer pays {{amount}} RWF towards the worker's treatment.

ussd.title: Basic phone
ussd.subtitle: No smartphone or no data? Find jobs, finish a job with the client's code and check your earnings by dialling a short code from any phone.
ussd.how1: From any phone, dial {{code}} on a number you have confirmed in Settings. No internet or app is needed, and it costs nothing to the worker.
ussd.how2: Choose by number: 1 lists open jobs in your trades and lets you apply, 2 shows the job you are doing and takes the client's 4-digit code to get paid, 3 shows your earnings, 4 switches between Kinyarwanda and English. 0 goes back.
ussd.how3: This screen runs the same menus as your own account, so you can try it here. In the pilot the short code is served through a USSD gateway such as Africa's Talking.

workers.title: Find workers
workers.subtitle: Choose who does the job. Every skill shows how it was proven, and you pay into escrow only once the worker accepts.
workers.none: No workers match. Try fewer filters.

workers.offered: Offer sent to {{name}}. You will be told when they answer.
